package codestructuretype

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// DeleteCodeStructureType removes structure type.
type DeleteCodeStructureType struct {
	Structures repository.CodeStructureTypeRepository
}

// Handle deletes structure type by id.
func (uc DeleteCodeStructureType) Handle(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	return uc.Structures.Delete(ctx, id)
}
